data.one_liner: Provides API for interacting with top-level Flutter windows.
data.what_it_does: Provides an API for interacting with top-level Flutter windows across multiple platforms. It is packaged as a plugin supporting web, windows, macos, and linux.
use_when: You need to interact with top-level windows in a Flutter desktop or web application.
You want cross-platform window management support including Linux, Windows, macOS, and web.
avoid_when: You are building a mobile-only application.
You do not need any top-level window manipulation features.
strengths: Supports multiple platforms including web, windows, macos, and linux.
Simple API for interacting with top-level windows.
weaknesses: Limited documentation beyond the basic description.
